result: Local software checks passed; native Windows CI and physical Tobii validation are separate.
verified: Frontend production build and Electron TypeScript build.
All active routes, 14 Settings pages, navigation centring/equal dimensions, target clearance, overlap, text fit and viewport fit in the screen matrix.
Production target picker at nine interior points per measured patient target; registered backend geometry agrees with the painted DOM.
Target registry follows resize, navigation, mode changes and keyboard expanded display.
Keyboard geometry, typography and gaze attributes unchanged by colour layer; both keyboard feels, numeric/letter/expanded views, populated and empty predictions.
Real isolated backend: word/phrase suggestions, top/bottom slots, insertion and recovery after WebSocket reconnection.
Synthetic gaze dwell: one correct activation, no duplicates; real room opening, zoom, rotation, finish selection and return-to-map actions.

Compass geometry, ground-only scope, incomplete upper floor, four alternatives, previews, PNG/PDF/DXF, resource bounds, cancellation, 429 recovery, object URL disposal and legacy saved-plan compatibility.
Windows source/vendor inputs, release validator failure cases, startup/stdio contracts and allowlisted Electron floorplan transport.
Dwell sets, gaze palettes, home migration, Settings persistence, word slots, Zone Board, browser gaze/lifecycle and TTS routing regressions.
intentional_cursor_difference: When an expanded letter hit area reaches a real keyboard action, the visible action owns its own rectangle. Empty-gap letter assistance is retained. Two targeted gaze regressions cover this baseline defect.
verification_repairs: Food migration check now accounts for the later Home profile version.
Music check verifies the current Home tile/action contract.
Compass browser audit waits for the new preview to finish; consecutive room-picker dwell cases close the preceding modal.
limitations: No physical Tobii tracker, Windows 11 laptop, installed EXE or patient comfort/latency session was available on this Mac. Passing virtual gaze checks is not a hardware accuracy guarantee.
Native Windows CI is configured on push for this branch and the source feature branch; consult the GitHub run for its result. Windows hosted CI does not replace a Windows 11/Tobii session.
One pyttsx3 runtime test skipped because pyttsx3 is absent here; browser speech and Windows SAPI output were not heard/validated.
Legacy offline ML training tests excluded because optional PyTorch is absent. The default deterministic prediction runtime was tested, including spawned worker recovery.

ORTools is absent from this Mac venv, so the complete legacy floorplan executable self-test was not run locally. Its Compass-specific self-test passed; Windows CI installs the pinned runtime and runs the complete self-test.
The 25 local music files are not imported in this checkout. Music navigation/player layout was verified, not playback of those files.
Native YouTube playback and graphics-driver stalls were not measured; IPC wiring, BrowserView bounds/closure and browser gaze safeguards were checked.
